ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the lines AB and CD intersect at point O. If $\angle BOD = 40^\circ$ and OA bisects $\angle COE$, what is the measure of $\angle AOE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle BOD = 40^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle AOC = \angle BOD = 40^\circ$,\\
since OA bisects $\angle COE$,\\
therefore $\angle AOE = \angle AOC = \boxed{40^\circ}$.
